title: Emily Blunt Reveals She Studied Real-Life Alien Sightings for 'Disclosure Day'
excerpt: Emily Blunt revealed her inspiration source to portray her character in Disclosure Day.
content:
Emily Blunt took an intense approach to research, plunging deep into real-life alien sighting accounts for her role in Disclosure Day. Stories about extraterrestrial life have always fascinated people for generations, yet much about them remains unknown. To prepare for the challenge of bringing such a story to life, Blunt revealed that she had to go beyond the script. 

So, the actress adopted an entirely different approach to preparing for the role, which in turn changed her perspective on these stories.

Emily Blunt reveals her research source for Disclosure Day

Emily Blunt plays the role of a TV meteorologist, Margaret, in Disclosure Day. However, she revealed that she had no point of reference for the experiences her character has had. And that made her go through stories of alleged encounters with extraterrestrial life.

“I just had nothing to springboard, to base [my character on] other than watching endless documentaries about people who have experienced something and the reality of what that felt like for them,” she said in an interview with Discussing Film.

Her research included watching congressional hearings and documentaries about people who reported encounters with mysterious phenomena. This experience also had an impact on her. Speaking on The Brandon Davis Show, the actress revealed that she was impressed by the genuine sincerity with which people shared their stories.

"I think that the thing that I was struck by was how inarguable it seemed to me that people were lying. There was this absolute peaceful truth pouring out of them,” she said.

The actress revealed that learning about other people’s stories raised several questions in her heart. And this curiosity and urge to explore became a huge part of how she portrayed her character, Margaret, on screen. As for the question part, this was perhaps what director Steven Spielberg may have wanted to.

Spielberg in his interviews, explained that the movie is more than just exploring extraterrestrial life.

Steven Spielberg reveals complicated questions posed by Disclosure Day

Steven Spielberg’s movie follows humanity as it comes face to face with evidence of extraterrestrial life. However, the film also explores deeper human questions. More than science, these questions revolve around faith, belief, and humanity’s place in the universe.

"Is God our God only on this planet, or is God a God for every system where there's civilization?" Spielberg said on CBS's Sunday Morning.

Rather than offering answers, Disclosure Day uses the idea of extraterrestrial life to explore larger questions about faith, belief, and human understanding. And Blunt’s extensive research helped her portray her character. And through both its story and characters, the film throws the same questions at the viewers.
